{{Quote|Grab that bottle of Fury. That’s it. Now stop messing with the glass and pour something into it.|[[Mandalore the Avenger|Shae Vizla]]|<ref name="Bottled Fury">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20221117|text="Bottled Fury"|int=Bottled Fury}}</ref>}}
'''Fury''' was a hard [[Liquor/Legends|liquor]] in the era of the [[Third Galactic War]]. Associated with drunken fights, it was known for its unusual strength and harsh, unpleasant taste, as well as its flammable properties. 

Fury was served in the asteroid station of [[Mek-Sha]] when [[Mandalore the Avenger|Shae Vizla]] went there on a [[Mission to Mek-Sha (Mandalore the Avenger)|hunt]] for her enemy [[Heta Kol]]. Vizla used the drink to her advantage when a group of assailants from the [[Dar'manda]] gang cornered her in a cantina. She tossed a bottle of Fury into the air and shot it so that it sprayed all over them. She threatened to torch them with her [[Flamethrower/Legends|flamethower]] while they were covered in the combustible beverage.<ref name="Bottled Fury" />
